item.title: Version 2.4.1
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.4.1

  • Fixes a crash that could close iPod Drop after a few minutes of use (a layout loop in the library window).
  • The window always fits your screen. On setups with more than one display, the bottom of the window (with the player) could hang off the screen. It now fits the display it's on, also after you plug in or rearrange displays.
  • The progress card floats just above the player, and the player no longer shows an old time after its song is removed.
  • Error reports now include the latest crash report, so problems are easier to fix.
